relations.title: Capacidad interna después de la salida
JubAp.Net Frontier Operations Role in the IMSV.org Circle
relations.reading: Institutional preservation can keep a capability available while leaving its contribution, recognition and legal rights as separate questions.

relations.title: Human Intelligence Debt
relations.reading: Reducing compensatory human work and improving capability recognition are distinct outcomes that require separate measures.

relations.title: The Human Intelligence Debt Dilemma: A Game-Theoretic Account of Why Rational Agents Build Irrational Architectures
relations.reading: The attribution ratchet sharpens one incentive mechanism behind architectural complexity: blame remains attached to the source while credit is captured downstream.

relations.title: Attribution Gap Measurement Protocol
relations.reading: Lineage establishes dependency, while contribution still requires independently evidenced consequences, substitution conditions and a reliable scoring protocol.

relations.title: When Cleaning Up Means Betting Blind
relations.reading: The proposed sequence is to reconstruct contribution and replacement consequences before turning ownership clarity into a capability-retirement decision.

relations.title: The Coordination Entropy Trap in Large Scale Programs
relations.reading: Before replacing a local database, reconstruct the corrections and capabilities it supports; a cleaner ownership map is not evidence that its contribution has been replaced.

relations.title: JubAp.Net Tiger Team Model
relations.reading: Compressed accountability should not become concentrated blame without matching authority or visible contribution.

relations.title: Tiger Team Compression Model
relations.reading: Successful engineering needs an institutional handover that preserves ownership, maintenance capacity and recognition after the intervention team leaves.

relations.title: JubAp.Net GEPLAN and the Hidden Logistics Lab Behind PEMEX Operations
relations.reading: An expanding operational role can reveal previously unrecognized capability, which still requires bounded contribution and replacement evidence before being valued.

relations.title: Nestlé North America — Where JUBAP Was Named
relations.reading: Facilitator capability can outlast an intervention only if learning is accompanied by durable ownership, resourcing and recognition, rather than enthusiasm alone.

relations.title: THE DIAMOND INSIDE FRAMEWORK
relations.reading: Diamond Inside's value-discovery proposition can be examined through the revaluation-before-clarification hypothesis without treating a potential opportunity as realized financial value.

relations.title: Field Intelligence in Chicontepec and the Texas–Mérida Corridor
relations.reading: The corridor invites a bounded attribution study of where a capability is created, maintained and capitalized, rather than inferring its value from the location that books the revenue.

relations.title: Surviving Capability: Why the Field Celebrates What the Theory Condemns
relations.reading: The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.

relations.title: Narrativa, centro y frontera: por qué los modelos simples fallan cuando llega la implementación
relations.reading: One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.

relations.title: Narrativa, centro y frontera: por qué los modelos simples fallan cuando llega la implementación
relations.reading: Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.

relations.title: Reference Failure Scenario and Quality-Gate Plan: Rights-Provenance Inversion — “The Author Pays for Their Own Work”
relations.reading: Authentic provenance, permission to use and contribution credit are different propositions; evidence for one should not silently decide the others.

relations.title: Annex 01K-A02 — Human Intelligence Debt: aceleración económica y experimentos de segundo orden
relations.reading: A later economic question is whether correcting attribution changes effective withdrawal and allocation rights, rather than only symbolic credit.

relations.title: La solución pudo decirse muchas veces y seguir siendo inaudible
relations.reading: Una contribución que circula sin ser reconocida permite leer el Attribution Gap desde la capacidad que la organización deja de percibir y, por ello, puede dejar de sostener.

relations.title: La propiedad intelectual protege una etapa, no toda la vida de una capacidad
relations.reading: El ciclo de descubrimiento, atribución y transferencia permite preguntar qué capacidad se pierde cuando solo se reconoce un resultado, pero no a quienes lo hacen posible.
